notes.title: Machinefall Demo Update: Enter the Stone Age!
notes.content:
[h2]Survivors, the wasteland just got a whole lot more primal![/h2][p]
New release of Machinefall’s Demo update, introducing an all-new Stone Age Technology Era is out![/p][p]This update adds a gritty new layer of survival and strategy, where every stone and spark matters. Whether you’re carving out a new tribe or reforging your empire from the rubble, the Stone Age offers new ways to adapt, fight, and thrive in the ruins of Machinefall.[/p][p]The update is live now — sharpen your stones and step into humanity’s fight for survival.[/p]

notes.title: Concept of the Game
notes.content:
[h1]Machinefall: A New Dawn in the War Against the Machines[/h1]
Humanity teeters on the edge of extinction. The Earth, once a thriving home, is now a battleground—its ruins patrolled by an insect-like army of relentless machines. Nobody remembers the details of the Great War that led to this dark era, only that it was lost. Now, scattered survivors live under the oppressive rule of the machines, waiting for a leader to rise.

Welcome to Machinefall, a real-time strategy game set in a post-apocalyptic world where you must rebuild, fight, and reclaim the planet.

[h1]Survive and Rebuild[/h1]
Your journey begins with only a handful of units, dropped into a location of your choice anywhere on the planet. Whether in the frozen tundra, dense jungle, or the shattered remains of a once-great metropolis, survival is your first challenge. Resources are scarce, and danger is everywhere.

To stand a chance, you must establish a colony—constructing shelters, training soldiers, and setting up production lines for weapons, armor, and vehicles. Your workers operate factories and gather vital resources, staying close to their homes as they keep your growing army supplied.

[h1]Wage War on Land, Sea, and Air[/h1]
The machines control the world, and breaking their hold won’t be easy. You'll need a diverse military force:

[list]
[*] [b]Infantry[/b]: Versatile and upgradeable, soldiers gain experience, level up, and rise through the ranks.
[*] [b]Ground Vehicles[/b]: From light scout vehicles to heavily armored tanks, these units form the backbone of your offensive and defensive operations.
[*] [b]Naval Fleet[/b]: Control the seas with warships and amphibious assault craft to expand your reach across oceans.
[*] [b]Air Forces[/b]: Swift and deadly, aircraft allow you to strike deep into enemy territory and provide support for ground forces.
[/list]

Every unit matters, and strategic planning is essential. A reckless charge into enemy territory could result in disaster, while a well-coordinated attack can liberate entire regions.

[h1]Technology and Warfare[/h1]
Advancement is key to survival. Unlock new technologies by salvaging old-world knowledge. Research leads to stronger armor, deadlier weapons, and more efficient production techniques. As your colony grows, so does your ability to fight back.

Defenses are just as important as offense. Walls can help hold back machine invasions while you prepare for larger operations.

[h1]Liberate and Expand[/h1]
Scattered across the globe are the remains of fallen cities—once thriving hubs of human civilization, now suffer under machine control. Reclaiming these ruins is crucial. Each liberated city boosts your population, providing more workers, soldiers, and resources to fuel the war effort.

But the machines will not sit idly by. Every action you take draws their attention. The more territory you reclaim, the stronger their response. The war escalates as you push deeper into their domain, forcing you to constantly adapt your strategies.

[h1]A Fight for Humanity’s Future[/h1]
In Machinefall, the battle never stops. The machines are vast in number and unrelenting in their pursuit of total control. Your leadership is the only hope for humanity.

Will you rebuild and lead the resistance to victory, or will the machines crush the last remnants of human civilization?
